requirements.description: Can it cleanly fix a bad word in a recording without making a 'click' or pop sound at the edit point?
How short can the voice sample be for cloning? Can it work with a 3-second clip?
Does it support cross-lingual stuff out of the box (like making an English speaker speak French)?
Does it also work as a denoiser? Can we feed it noisy audio and get clean speech out?
How well does it capture the emotion of the prompt? Does it sound robotic or expressive?
